title: Native names
description: What cst branch --json and cst tag --json print in a native repository (CLI output; native/cli/src/native_names.rs, ADR-0047 decisions 9, 10 and 12): the names listed, branches, tags and remote-tracking names (docs/native-history/operations.md §2), in order of kind, then of name in byte order. Every name a listing shows is listed, a symbolic one whose target names nothing and a conflicted one included. A name's bytes need not be UTF-8: name holds them decoded with replacement, and nameHex holds them, in lowercase hex, exactly when they are not UTF-8. v2 holds a conflicted name's sides and bases where v1 required a target (#424).

name.description: A name, with its target when it is resolved, or the sides and bases of a conflicted one, which two operations moved apart and which names every side until someone chooses (operations.md §2.1, §3.3); exactly one of target and conflicted.
The name, without its kind's namespace, such as main or origin/main.

nameHex.description: The name as stored, present only when it is not UTF-8.

local.description: Whether a branch is local, which N5 never sends unless asked; false for every other kind.

adds.description: The sides, at least two, in the order the merge gives them; null is a side that deleted the name.

removes.description: The bases the sides moved from, one fewer than the adds; null is a base that held no such name.

side.description: A target as causet.names/v1 holds one, or null for absent.
